    A small model of a ray category #

    For a category P whose Hom-types are w-small (for instance finite), RaySmall.{w} P has the same objects (wrapped) and Hom-types Shrink.{w} (X ⟶ Y); zero morphisms and the ray axioms transfer along equivShrink. This gives a model of the ray category of an algebra in Category.{0}, as required by the covering data.
